capabilities: keep audio playing when its embed scrolls out of view
resume each note's playback position on return
seek, skip, and change playback speed from a now-playing bar
control playback via commands and hotkeys
extras: Video embeds are explicitly left untouched; the plugin states it makes no network requests and no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian's embedded audio players stop or become inaccessible when you scroll the embed away, and playback position is not remembered between visits to a note.
summary: Audio playback helper that keeps embedded audio playing from a pinned now-playing bar when the embed scrolls out of view and remembers position per note.
